rules.objective: Get rid of cards and avoid taking the central pile during slap challenges.
rules.gameplay: Players take turns revealing cards while saying the next word in the fixed phrase. When the spoken word matches the revealed card, or a special slap card appears, players race to slap the pile; the last player takes it.
keyRules: Players chant Taco, Cat, Goat, Cheese, Pizza in order while revealing cards.
A match between word and card triggers a slap race.
The last player to slap takes the pile.

synthesis.shortDescription: Crazy Eights is a popular shedding card game, especially beloved by children. The objective is simple: be the first player to discard all your cards.

prompts.human: Crazy Eights is a popular shedding card game, especially beloved by children. The objective is simple: be the first player to discard all your cards. Players take turns playing cards to a central discard pile, matching either the rank or suit of the top card. The eponymous "crazy" 8s are wild cards that can be played on anything and allow the player to change the suit.
